translations.Accesso opzionale ai dati VIIRS e AOD: Optional access to VIIRS and AOD data
translations.Crea l'account Earthdata, conferma l'e-m: Create an Earthdata account, confirm the activation email, and sign in.
translations.Apri Modifica profilo e compila tutti i: Open Edit Profile and complete every field, including those marked optional: organization, affiliation, user type, and study area. Enter truthful information that applies to you.
translations.In NightScope inserisci nome utente e pa: In NightScope, enter your username and password. Then select Save and Test connection.
translations.Se richiesto, seleziona Autorizza app, s: If prompted, select Authorize app, check every authorization option requested by LAADS OPeNDAP, and confirm with Authorize. Then return to NightScope and repeat the test.
Create an OpenAQ account and sign in.
translations.Apri la pagina dell'account dal menu del: Open the account page from the profile menu and scroll to the API Keys section.
translations.Crea o copia la chiave API. Trattala com: Create or copy the API key. Treat it like a password and do not share it.
translations.In NightScope incolla la chiave, selezio: In NightScope, paste the key, select Save, then Test connection. Setup is complete when the status shows Verified.
translations.Terminatore ben definito: filtro lunare: Well-defined terminator: moon filter recommended for apertures over 100 mm.
translations.La posizione di sistema non è disponibil: System location is unavailable. Choose a city or enter coordinates manually.
System location is unavailable. Try approximate online location?
translations.Usa GeoClue per richiedere la posizione: Use GeoClue to request the system location. Availability and accuracy depend on the location services configured in the Linux distribution.
translations.Cerca città, osservatorio o codice MPC: Search for a city, observatory, or MPC code
translations.Digita una città, un osservatorio o un c: Enter a city, observatory, or MPC code.
translations.Le dimensioni del sensore e il passo pix: Sensor dimensions and pixel size must be greater than zero.
translations.Il frame rate deve essere maggiore di ze: Frame rate must be greater than zero.
translations.Il ΔT massimo sotto ambiente deve essere: Maximum cooling ΔT below ambient must be greater than zero.
translations.Il backfocus deve essere maggiore di zer: Back focus distance must be greater than zero.
translations.Compila tutti i campi video oppure lasci: Complete all video fields or leave them blank.
translations.I valori video devono essere maggiori di: Video values must be greater than zero.
